body:
Real FLOAT/DOUBLE (⚫/⚪) Door type support in the LO emitter, per LO_Formal_Grammar_Phase_0_Complete.md §7.2/7.3. Both map to PARENA F64 (no F32 exists in PARENA, confirmed against src/emit.c) via a small in-module lo-i32-to-f64 cast helper. Found and solved a real verification gap: (defn main [] : F64 ...) mangles to double main(void), whose process exit code is undefined behavior, so a new #define-main-rename driver + printf/stdout parsing technique was built (compileRunAndGetFloat) instead of the exit-code approach used for I32. Two new real end-to-end tests (TestEmitFloatDoorRunsCorrectly, TestEmitDoubleDoorRunsCorrectly), GRAMMAR.md backfilled with the missing Switch/Case/Default/Lambda/Call/FLOAT/DOUBLE EBNF entries. 28 tests pass. commit 13a2934.

⚓ ☃
title: FLOAT/DOUBLE Door type support
